WITH order_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    AVG(remaincount) as avg_remaincount,
    COUNT(*) as exec_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE expirespot > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496'
    AND expirespot < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
  GROUP BY ordersmark
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_remaincount) as avg_of_averages,
  SUM(exec_count) as total_executions
FROM order_stats
